regulator.value: TASE (ISA-supervised exchange) for every member; the Bank of Israel for banks' stability
regulator.notes: Trading on TASE goes only through TASE members: banks, non-bank members (חש"בים) and remote members (BRK-01, BRK-32). TASE supervises members under its rules, which the ISA approves; for banks that supervision covers trading and conduct only, their stability being the Bank of Israel's (BRK-04). The ISA supervises TASE itself (REG-13). A foreign broker reached under a section 49A permit is not ISA-supervised (BRK-06); a pending broker-dealer bill would add an ISA licence (BRK-05, secondary).

source.title: Banking (Service to Customer) (Fees) Rules 2008, consolidated to 5.11.2024, first schedule part 4(א)(1)

trade.notes: No regulatory cap. For banks the rules fix the fee type (a percentage of the trade with a minimum and a maximum, separately for shares and bonds and for makam) but each bank sets the price; a direct-channel fee must be lower than the clerk fee; two weeks' notice of changes. Non-bank members follow the same part structure; their tariff is a ceiling and negotiated prices exist. TASE publishes every member's average fees actually charged, by security type and portfolio band.

source.title: Banking (Service to Customer) (Fees) Rules 2008, consolidated to 5.11.2024, first schedule part 4(א)(5) and notes

custody.notes: No regulatory cap on the rate (banks: a percentage with a maximum per deposit, price set by the bank). Banks may not charge it at all on makam or on money-market fund units (BRK-17, BANK-18); the ban binds banks only, and no rule limits a non-bank member's custody fee on them (BRK-17, BRK-52; BRK open question 11 closed 2026-10-26). Non-bank members name it דמי משמרת or דמי ניהול/טיפול פיקדון ני"ע.

source.title: Banking (Service to Customer) (Fees) Rules 2008, consolidated to 5.11.2024, first schedule part 5 (עמלת חליפין)

fx.notes: No regulatory cap. A bank converts at its rate plus the conversion fee when a foreign security is paid for or sold without enough foreign currency in the account (Leumi terms); non-bank members charge a conversion fee or a spread on the rate (מרווח המרה).

source.title: IBI tariff (1.7.2026); Excellence, Altshuler Shaham Trade and Psagot tariffs read 2026-10-22
source.publisher: IBI; Excellence; Altshuler Shaham Trade; Psagot

fixed_period.notes: A monthly account fee (דמי טיפול, דמי שימוש, דמי ניהול תקופתיים) and a monthly fee for advanced systems or real-time quotes appear in non-bank tariffs; no cap found. A bank may charge only for services in the Governor's full tariff, or added with the Supervisor's approval (BANK-16, BRK-16).

source.title: Altshuler Shaham Trade and Psagot tariffs (fee on interest, dividend and redemption payments), read 2026-10-22

distribution_handling.notes: A fee on dividend, coupon and redemption payments appears in some non-bank tariffs (טיפול בתשלומי ריבית/דיבידנד); no cap found. The clearing house and the nominee company pass the payments to the member gross.

source.title: Banking (Service to Customer) (Fees) Rules 2008, consolidated to 9.4.2025, first schedule part 4(א)(6) notes, part 5 item 10

transfer_out.notes: Banks only: moving the portfolio to the same client's account at another financial body on closing the account costs at most NIS 10 for the transfer and third-party costs; while the account stays open the per-transfer price is supervised and set outside the rules (not found, BRK OQ12; Discount lists NIS 5 per transfer, institution). Non-bank members have no cap found and charge per security (SW-34).

labels: secondary source: an accumulating foreign-domiciled fund is taxed only at sale (TXF-11; TXF OQ1)
institution source: tax when securities move between accounts without a sale (SW-36; SW OQ11)

lawful_exit.text: any TASE trading day (Monday to Friday since 5.1.2026): sell on the exchange, or redeem Israeli ETF and fund units through the member; the proceeds settle through the TASE clearing house. The settlement cycle for secondary trades is not sourced (GOV OQ7). Foreign funds on TASE and foreign-domiciled funds are sold on an exchange only.

source.title: Income Tax Ordinance, s.88 definition of "מכירה" (includes exchange and redemption); s.101A(a)(12)

switch_is_tax_event.notes: Selling one fund or security to buy another is a sale: tax on any real gain is withheld even if the money never leaves the account (TXS-21). Moving securities in kind to your own account at another member is described by institutions as not a tax event, with the cost basis carried over; no Tax Authority source was read (SW-36, SW OQ11).

eligibility.text: anyone who opens a securities account at a bank that is a TASE member or at a non-bank TASE member (a written custody agreement at a bank); minimums are provider-set (Fair from NIS 250; Meitav Trade NIS 5,000 or 10,000, inconsistent on its own page); rules for minors' accounts were not found (BRK OQ17); a foreign broker is reached directly or through a section 49A permit holder (BRK OQ9); trading is on TASE trading days, Monday to Friday since 5.1.2026

protection.text: at a non-bank member, TASE rules require client securities and cash to be held apart from the member's own, in trust, at the clearing house and at banks, with a yearly independent audit; no statute segregating them was found, and what happens if the member fails is open (REG OQ9). At a bank, securities are registered through the nominee company and kept apart from the bank's own in its books (one bank's terms); what happens to them if the bank fails is not sourced (REG OQ10, BRK OQ5), and deposits are not insured. The clearing house guarantees settlement between members, not a client's balance. No Israeli investor-compensation scheme was found. Abroad: SIPC for a US broker-dealer and the Irish scheme for IB Ireland, as stated by those bodies
